messages:
Alex: FYI partner cloud reported a regression after the new driver/CUDA stack landed in their marketplace images. latency up ~2x on long-context workloads.
Mira: which driver + cuda combo?
Alex: They pinned to NVIDIA driver 535.86 + CUDA 12.3 yesterday; after we pushed marketplace image with driver 540.12 + CUDA 13.0 they started seeing KV-cache stalls.
Dan: ugh. Any crash logs or stack traces?
Alex: partner attached a small repro and perf logs. snippet shows big stall during KV lookup loop. no OOM, just huge token latency.
Partner CI Bot: nightly-inference-e2e failed on marketplace-image-2026-03-20 (job 4821) - see https://ci.partner/4821
Katie: @NVIDIA Eng can you triage if 540.12 introduced any kernel ordering or barrier changes that could affect kv-cache refills?
NVIDIA Eng: looking. earliest guess: some L2 caching heuristics changed in 540 that affect memcpy ordering for >48k states. will confirm.
Jordan: ops question — do we want to fastpatch marketplace image to pin driver 535/CUDA12.3 as a stopgap, or try a micro-hotfix with the partner and nv driver?
Anita: pinning is fastest for customer impact. but we should avoid a long-term fork. recommend: 1) pin marketplace image to 535+12.3, 2) open a joint hotfix ticket with NVIDIA & partner, 3) run a canary with workload-specific traces.
Dan: agree. can we create a pinned tag and a rollback playbook? I can draft the manifest change.
Mira: add cost/latency telemetry alert so we detect any residual regressions post-rollback. also record exact model + seq len used by partner.
Alex: here's a minimal example of the marketplace pin we can apply to their terraform manifest:
```
resource "marketplace_image" "inference" {
  name = "partner-llm-runtime"
  driver_version = "535.86"
  cuda_version = "12.3"
  image_tag = "2026-03-20-pin-535"
}
```
Katie: timeline? partner needs mitigation within 4 hours ideally.
NVIDIA Eng: will prioritize. asking FW and driver teams now. I expect a micro-patch might take 24-72h; pining should be the immediate step.
Jordan: I'll schedule a 30m sync with partner + NVIDIA Eng in 30 minutes. invite sent.
Anita: assign owners: Jordan = partner comms, Dan = rollback manifest and CI job, Mira = telemetry + canary dashboard, Alex = release notes + partner announcement draft, Katie = escalation to enterprise account exec if SLA at risk.
Dan: started PR to pin tag and created rollback runbook: https://git.internal/runs/9182 (CI queued).
Partner CI Bot: canary pipeline started against pinned image (job 4823).
Alex: when can we confirm canary results?
Mira: hope to have initial numbers in 45m. will post results in this thread.
NVIDIA Eng: once we confirm root cause, we'll share recommended driver patch and timelines. will keep this thread updated. :handshake:
